comparator_object_classes.name: non_comparable
comparator_object_classes.meaning: No stable human-channel mapping, no homologous measurement contract, or no defensible shared comparison domain.

comparator_object_classes.name: structurally_comparable
comparator_object_classes.meaning: A bounded structural mapping can be stated between machine-side bridge artifacts and future human-side comparator artifacts.

comparator_object_classes.name: interventional_comparable
comparator_object_classes.meaning: A matched intervention family can be specified for both machine-side and human-side channels under explicit burden symmetry.

comparator_object_classes.name: weakly_homologous
comparator_object_classes.meaning: Some descriptive overlap exists, but the overlap is too weak for strong comparator burdens.

comparator_object_classes.name: comparator_underdefined
comparator_object_classes.meaning: Comparator language exists, but the object, channels, or burden tables are still underspecified.

comparator_object_classes.name: comparator_blocked_by_missing_human_channel
comparator_object_classes.meaning: Machine-side bridge artifacts exist, but no legitimate human measurement channel has been opened for the target burden.

comparator_domains.name: bridge_coordinate_domain
comparator_domains.role: Compare future human-side measurements to machine-side bridge coordinates under shared typing and normalization rules.

comparator_domains.name: intervention_response_domain
comparator_domains.role: Compare response signatures under matched intervention and matched negative-control families.

comparator_domains.name: transport_preservation_domain
comparator_domains.role: Compare preservation or fracture across substrate transitions under explicit invariance burdens.

comparator_domains.name: artifact_lineage_domain
comparator_domains.role: Compare only artifacts with traceable provenance, schema lineage, and version compatibility.

comparator_burdens.name: human_channel_burden
comparator_burdens.statement: No human comparator program may proceed without an explicit human-side channel definition, artifact contract, and measurement error model.

comparator_burdens.name: burden_symmetry
comparator_burdens.statement: Machine-side and human-side comparisons must use homologous burdens rather than asymmetric descriptive convenience.

comparator_burdens.name: intervention_homology
comparator_burdens.statement: Interventional comparisons require matched perturbations, matched controls, and explicit channel limitations.

comparator_burdens.name: traceability_burden
comparator_burdens.statement: Comparator artifacts must remain lineage-traceable, schema-typed, and surface-restricted.

interpretation_boundary: Stage 2-M2 opens bounded comparative runtime assessment after BPF-M3 internal bridge closure. It defines comparator objects, burdens, blocked states, and runtime assessment surfaces, but it does not emit human comparator verdicts, human equivalence verdicts, cross-substrate verdicts, external adjudication logic, or Paper 10 logic.
